title: Chip manufacturing process size (nanometers)

source.name: Intel 4004 (1971) process size vs. TSMC leading-edge 'N2' process (2025 ramp)
source.publisher: Intel Corp. (4004 datasheet/history); TSMC technology roadmap disclosures

notes: The Intel 4004 (1971), the first commercial microprocessor, used a 10,000-nanometer (10-micrometer) process. TSMC's 'N2' node, the leading commercial process ramping in 2025, is marketed at roughly 2 nanometers; a silicon atom is about 0.2 nanometers across, so 2nm-class features are only a handful of atoms wide.
